subject: Acme SOC 2 / Audit evidence follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Brian Turner <brian.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme SOC 2 / Audit evidence follow-up

Hi Brian —

Great to meet today — thank you for walking us through Acme's requirements. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have alignment: 

Key pain points you shared:
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a control mapping for how Redwood's controls map to Acme's scope (auth, logging, change management).
- Requirement for audit logs and retention policy (30/90/365 day retention questions).
- DPA and subprocessor disclosures + timeline for signature.
- Desire for penetration test evidence or summary report for third-party assessment.

Goals we heard:
- Confirm that audit logs and exportable retention settings meet Acme's 12-month retention requirement for key logs.
- Provide SOC 2 summary and control matrix within 3 business days.
- Provide a redlined DPA and sign within two weeks to enable a pilot.
- If needed, arrange a 30-min technical session with Dev/Neha on log schema and retention APIs.

Proposed next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Share SOC 2 summary & control mapping (Marissa) — attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_control_matrix.xlsx — by EOD Wed (2026-08-12).
2) Share penetration test summary (if available) or attest to timing for sharing redacted report (Dev) — by Fri (2026-08-14).
3) Send standard DPA to Acme for review (Marissa) — DocuSign link included below; aim to execute within 2 weeks.
4) Technical deep dive (Neha + Dev) — propose 30-min slot next week to validate log delivery and retention API — please suggest times.

I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and control matrix in my next email. If I've missed anything important from today's call, please flag and I'll update.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: (will send in follow-up) redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_control_matrix.xlsx
From: Brian Turner <brian.turner@acme.com>

Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 / Audit evidence follow-up

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

- For retention: we require 12 months for authentication and admin audit logs. Can you confirm if Redwood supports configurable retention or if logs can be exported to our SIEM for long-term storage?
- For pen test evidence: Acme security typically accepts either a redacted full report or a summary letter from the vendor. Do you have a redacted report we can review, or can you provide a vendor contact?
- DPA: please send the DocuSign and we will route to legal. We may redline a few clauses.

Also confirm the hosting region for the pilot (we require US-only for this initial phase).

Proposed times for the technical session next week: Tue 8/17 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 8/18 14:00–15:00 PT. Let me know which works.

Thanks,
Brian Turner
Director, Information Security — Acme Corp
Brian.Turner@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 / Audit evidence follow-up

Brian —

Thanks — please see attached SOC 2 summary and control matrix. Quick notes:

- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf: high-level scope and auditor statement (SOC 2 Type II, last audit cycle ending 2026-05-31). This is a summary; we can provide the SOC 2 report under NDA if required.
- redwood_control_matrix.xlsx: mapping of Redwood controls to common Acme requirements (auth, logging, change mgmt, incident response).
- redwood_pen_test_evidence_stub.txt: summary from our most recent third-party test (redacted vendor letter). Full redacted report can be shared with a DPA/NDA in place — we usually provide the redacted pen test report to customers under a confidentiality agreement.

Responses to your questions:
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable export and retention policies. For the pilot we can keep authentication and admin logs for 12 months, or we can provide a streaming export to your SIEM (syslog/S3). Neha will walk through the export options in the technical call.
- Pen test: attaching a summary; Dev can provide vendor contact.
- Hosting region: we will run the pilot in the US region (us-west-2) by default; confirm if that meets your requirement.

DocuSign: I've initiated the standard DPA for Acme — link: https://app.docusign.com/signet/envelope/0A1B2C3D-ACME-DPA (expected routing to your legal).

Next steps:
- Neha/Dev to run 30-min technical session (Neha: action) — propose Tue 8/17 10:00 PT as first choice.
- Marissa to follow up on full redacted pen test report process (Marissa/Dev).
